report_name: SoftBank Cloud Unit Crippled by Ransomware, 495 Orgs Affected

threat_actors.name: Unidentified Attackers
threat_actors.description: The unidentified threat actors responsible for the ransomware attack against IDC Frontier. They claimed to have encrypted the cloud region in seven minutes and destroyed over 554,000 snapshots to prevent recovery.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: The threat actors encrypted virtual servers and 225 data stores within IDC Frontier's East Japan Region 1, rendering them inaccessible to 495 customers.

attack_patterns.name: Inhibit System Recovery
attack_patterns.description: The attackers destroyed 554,000 snapshots, a direct action to prevent victims from restoring from backups and increase pressure to pay the ransom.

identities.name: IDC Frontier (IDCF)
identities.description: A Japanese cloud service provider and subsidiary of SoftBank that was the primary victim of the ransomware attack, leading to service disruption for 495 of its clients.

identities.name: SoftBank
identities.description: The parent company of IDC Frontier, the cloud provider targeted in the ransomware attack.

identities.name: Nissui Logistics Corp.
identities.description: A customer of IDC Frontier that was unable to process shipments at 17 distribution centers due to the ransomware attack on the cloud provider.

identities.name: JR East
identities.description: Japan's largest railway operator whose email services were affected by the ransomware attack on its cloud provider, IDC Frontier.

identities.name: Ibaraki Prefecture government
identities.description: A local government in Japan whose official website was taken offline as a result of the ransomware attack on its cloud provider, IDC Frontier.

identities.name: Ibaraki Prefecture police headquarters
identities.description: A local police headquarters in Japan whose official website was taken offline as a result of the ransomware attack on its cloud provider, IDC Frontier.
